analyzed_vuln.description: htmlParseSystemLiteral computes startPosition as CUR_PTR - BASE_PTR before scanning the quoted literal, then increments len while advancing with NEXT. In push-parsing/error paths, pointer movement can desynchronize such that BASE_PTR+startPosition no longer points to a valid in-buffer region for the recorded len. The function then calls xmlStrndup(BASE_PTR+startPosition, len) without revalidating that [start, start+len) is still within current input bounds, causing an out-of-bounds read in memcpy inside xmlStrndup.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via the html fuzz harness push parser (htmlParseChunk) with crafted malformed/invalid-byte HTML including a DOCTYPE external ID (SYSTEM/PUBLIC ... "..."). The parser enters htmlParseDocTypeDecl -> htmlParseExternalID -> htmlParseSystemLiteral; after consuming malformed bytes and quotes across parser buffer state, err remains 0 and the final xmlStrndup uses stale/invalid base-relative offsets, leading to a global-buffer-overflow read.
